<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Majin Duu''' is a Majin of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]], the raid of the Demon Realm, he leads the final wave alongside [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Kuu|Majin Kuu]]. With 800,000 health he has the most health of any raid boss.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Majin Duu is one of the two bosses of wave 5, with [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Kuu|Majin Kuu]] and 10 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah Soldier|Gomah Soldiers]]. Both bosses stay dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking one wakes it up early. Like every raid boss, he glows red. The raid is won once the whole wave is down.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid he has 800,000 health, 33,000 melee damage and 30,000 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Elite]] AI tier. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Majin Duu flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Ki attacks:''' pale green '''Ki Blast''', '''Ki Volley''' (a spray of small blasts) and '''Ki Wave'''.
* '''Gum Punch:''' he teleports in front of you and lands a heavy punch that sends you flying.
* '''Gum Expand:''' he teleports in front of you and strikes, knocking you back.
* '''Melee Combo:''' he teleports around you, striking from the front and from behind, and ends with a heavy blow.
* '''Dodging:''' he can step back out of the way of your hits.
* '''Teleporting:''' he teleports to you when you keep your distance or charge an attack from range.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Majin Duu drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army#Rewards|Gomah's Army]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''Majin Duu Appears''' has you defeat him on the Second Demon World.
</translate>
